value.rationale: A complete finite-size location/time classification for the standard symmetric cycle walk. Although last location is uniform, conditional expected times vary by floor((n-2)^2/4), a macroscopic effect of direct relevance to interpretation of cover times and late-point geometry. The calculation adds genuinely joint information beyond earlier marginal laws.
